claim: States the palette rule so accent, rim and background colours can be derived instead of guessed shot by shot. Analogous holds a scene together; triad and duotone are the ones that make a frame look designed rather than merely coloured.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: complementary color scheme, two opposing hues
triadic color scheme, three hue palette
monochromatic color scheme, single hue palette
warm and cool split palette, warm key cool shadow

review.issue: complementary ("complementary color scheme, two opposing hues") and split_complementary ("split complementary color scheme") will render identically - the model has no representation of the split variant, and the clause is a colour-theory term rather than anything visual. triad is nearly as weak.
review.fix: Drop split_complementary. Keep the harmonies with real visual signatures (monochrome, duotone, warm_cool_split, complementary, analogous) and, if triad survives, name the hues: "triadic colors, red green blue palette".
